system.description:
Ancient beyond any coven's memory of her arrival, Mother Loretta is said to have written down half the hexes every Witch in Arneyan still uses — usually without anyone crediting her for it.

  • She doesn't take students anymore.
  • She just occasionally shows up to collect what she considers owed.
  • Recipe (1st): Hag's Remedy.
  • Patron Curse (3rd): Once per day, unravel a piece of luck from a creature within 30ft: its next three d20 rolls within the hour are each rolled twice, worst result used (Will negates).
  • Physical Change (7th): Your hair greys prematurely regardless of true age, and small green shoots occasionally bud at your temples.
  • Advantage on Wisdom checks involving herbalism, folk remedies or oral tradition.
  • Once per day, as your action, spit a hex-laced tonic at a creature within 15ft: Fortitude save or Poisoned for the encounter.
